Joins 2026 code-violation counts per tract to CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 totalpopulation, and returns the paired tract set with the overall correlation and paired count ordered by violation rate descending.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT
    tc.geoid AS geoid,
    SUM(CAST(tc.n AS DOUBLE)) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts tc
  WHERE tc.run_id = 'r_20261025_d68050'
    AND tc.source = 'm1_city'
    AND tc.grp = 'all'
    AND tc.geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tc.geoid
),
health AS (
  SELECT
    c.tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(c.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(c.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_d68050_m2_cdc c
  WHERE c.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS name,
    t.geoid AS geoid,
    v.violation_count AS violation_count,
    h.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation,
    (v.violation_count / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
    h.bphigh_prevalence AS bphigh_prevalence,
    h.totalpop18plus AS totalpop18plus
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE v.violation_count IS NOT NULL
    AND h.bphigh_prevalence IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.name,
  p.code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  p.violation_count,
  p.totalpopulation,
  p.bphigh_prevalence,
  p.totalpop18plus,
  CORR(p.code_violations_per_1000_residents, p.bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  p.geoid
FROM paired p
ORDER BY p.code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, p.name ASC

sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT
    tc.geoid AS geoid,
    SUM(CAST(tc.n AS DOUBLE)) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts tc
  WHERE tc.run_id = 'r_20261025_d68050'
    AND tc.source = 'm1_city'
    AND tc.grp = 'all'
    AND tc.geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tc.geoid
),
health AS (
  SELECT
    c.tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(c.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(c.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_d68050_m2_cdc c
  WHERE c.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS name,
    t.geoid AS geoid,
    v.violation_count AS violation_count,
    h.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation,
    (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
    h.bphigh_prevalence AS bphigh_prevalence,
    h.totalpop18plus AS totalpop18plus
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE h.bphigh_prevalence IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.name,
  p.code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  p.violation_count,
  p.totalpopulation,
  p.bphigh_prevalence,
  p.totalpop18plus,
  CORR(p.code_violations_per_1000_residents, p.bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  p.geoid
FROM paired p
ORDER BY p.code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, p.name ASC

Joins all 71 Montgomery census tracts with CDC high-blood-pressure prevalence to 2026 code violation counts per tract, computes code violations per 1,000 residents using totalpopulation denominator, retains zero-violation tracts via LEFT JOIN and COALESCE, and returns correlation and paired_tracts over the full eligible set ordered by the violation rate.
sql:
WITH health AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(tractfips AS DOUBLE) AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_d68050_m2_cdc_v2
  WHERE bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
violations AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(CAST(n AS DOUBLE)) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_d68050' AND source = 'm1_city_v2'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.name AS name,
    v.violation_count AS violation_count,
    h.totalpopulation AS totalpopulation,
    h.totalpop18plus AS totalpop18plus,
    (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(h.totalpopulation, 0)) AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
    h.bphigh_prevalence AS bphigh_prevalence,
    t.geoid AS geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
)
SELECT
  name,
  code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  violation_count,
  totalpopulation,
  totalpop18plus,
  bphigh_prevalence,
  CORR(code_violations_per_1000_residents, bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
